_meta.purpose: Forward simulations give a range, because political events and decisions cannot be predicted. Each outlook multiplies the latest calibrated year (2025).

basis.us: US arrivals into Ontario fell 18% between 2019 and 2025, and US visitor spending in Niagara fell 10% in 2025 alone (trade tensions). Cross-border demand is the most political input, so it gets the widest band.
basis.domestic: Total visitor spending rose 16.5% in 2025 as Canadians travelled at home; that could continue or unwind.
basis.overseas: Overseas arrivals rose in 2025; long-haul travel swings with the economy and air capacity.
basis.base_stays: Hotel room nights outside leisure travel. Federal contracts housing asylum seekers ended in 2024-2025, removing winter room nights; a government decision could add or remove such stays again.
basis.resident: Household spending moves a few percent with jobs and prices.

_meta.seed: The size of each band is a judgement informed by the swings above, not a statistical estimate. Widen or narrow them here.
